children: Atlanticus Holdings completed sale of its CAR Auto Finance operations for approximately $71.2 million.
Sold CAR Auto Finance, which comprised 100% of the company's Auto Finance segment, to an unaffiliated third party.
Total consideration was about $71.2 million: $56.2 million cash and a $15.0 million seller note.
Approximately 154 CAR team members are transitioning to the buyer as part of the transaction.
Proceeds expected to be used to reduce debt and invest in higher-growth consumer credit product lines.
Following the sale, Atlanticus will no longer operate an Auto Finance segment and will refocus capital and management on core consumer credit offerings.
